name: Tomcat CGI - Command Injection (.bat/.cmd)
description: Windows CGI batch/cmd scripts pass query data to the shell. Fuzz for .bat/.cmd scripts, then append &<command> to execute OS commands (URL-encode as needed).

defense.why_it_works: Tomcat's CGI servlet (CVE-2019-0232, Windows only) passes URL query parameters as command-line arguments to cmd.exe via Runtime.exec(). Special characters in the query string inject additional commands into the argument list.
defense.prerequisites: Tomcat CGI servlet enabled on Windows. A .bat or .cmd CGI script in /cgi/. enableCmdLineArguments=true (default pre-fix).
defense.impact: Unauthenticated command injection as the Tomcat service user. Full Windows server compromise.
defense.detection: HTTP GET to /cgi/*.bat?& with injected commands. Windows Security Event 4688: new process created by Tomcat service. IDS alert for CGI command injection payload.
defense.artifacts: Tomcat access_log (GET /cgi/welcome.bat?&dir) | Windows Security Event 4688 | IDS alert for CGI injection pattern
defense.prevention: Update Tomcat to 9.0.18+, 8.5.40+. Set enableCmdLineArguments=false. Remove all CGI scripts if not required. Disable CGI servlet.
defense.misconfiguration: Tomcat CGI servlet enabled on Windows with enableCmdLineArguments=true. /cgi/ directory contains .bat files accessible from internet.
defense.code_review:
RED FLAGS (source): user input reaches a shell/exec call.
  system( / exec( / shell_exec( / passthru( / popen( / proc_open(  |  os.system / subprocess(..., shell=True)  |  child_process.exec(  |  backticks `...`
GREP:  grep -rniE "system\(|exec\(|shell_exec|passthru|popen|proc_open|os\.system|subprocess.*shell=True|child_process\.exec\(|`.*\$" .
SAFE:  avoid the shell; use argument arrays / execve-style APIs (subprocess.run([...], shell=False)); strict allowlist; escapeshellarg only as last resort.
defense.evasion: Keep the injected command short and single-shot; URL-encode to slip past naive WAF signatures; pull a full shell over a separate channel.
